Container.Name: cloudflared
Container.Overview: Cloudflare Tunnel that securely exposes your MCP servers (mcp-ynab, mcp-mediamanager, mcp-ancestry) to Claude.ai without opening firewall ports. Configure ingress rules in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard to route your custom domains to each MCP server's local port.

Config.Name: Tunnel Token
Config.Description: Your Cloudflare Tunnel token. Get it from Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard → Networks → Tunnels → your tunnel → Configure → Install and run a connector → copy the token value.
